entries.title: A crewmate's card that answers your message now counts as the answer
entries.body: When your first mate starts work from your choice on its card, the card that work's crewmate shows can now be the answer to your message. A choice you make while your first mate is still replying counts too. If the notice saying your first mate has not answered is already up, it goes away once a card that answers your message appears.
entries.noPicture: The cards look the same; what changed is when the app's notice appears, which a still picture cannot show.
